title: Inmigración
goal: Read how Argentina's policy of attracting European immigrants worked, and how they organized mutual aid societies and lived in crowded conventillos.

items: Explain Alberdi's argument for attracting European immigrants.
State why governments promoted the arrival of European settlers.
Explain how foreign-born Buenos Aires had become by 1914.
Describe what conventillos were and who lived in them.
Use para que + subjunctive to describe a deliberate policy's purpose.
I can explain Alberdi's argument for attracting European immigrants.
